title: 2005 AMC 8 Problem 4
statement: A square and a triangle have equal perimeters. The lengths of the three sides of the triangle are \(6.1\) cm, \(8.2\) cm and \(9.7\) cm. What is the area of the square in square centimeters?

solutions.text:
The perimeter of the triangle is \[ 6.1 + 8.2 + 9.7 = 24 \text{ cm.} \] This means that the side length of the square is \[ 24 \div 4 = 6 \text{ cm.} \] Therefore, the area of the square is \[ 6^2 = 36 \text{ cm}^2. \]

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: That perimeter is also the square’s perimeter.
